why: ONE CARD, ONE SWAP, AND THE PIP LOAD IS UNCHANGED. Archangel of Tithes is {1}{W}{W}{W} and White Sun's Zenith is {X}{W}{W}{W} — the same three white pips, so this tests the CARD and not the mana, which is why it was held out of skies-v1 rather than folded in. Archangel is the only card the flier sweep returned that does both jobs on one body: a 3/5 FLYING blocker against the seat that took 39 of 53 eliminations with nothing but evasive threats, and a taxer whose 'creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {1}' works whether or not the attacker flies, making it a third Propaganda beside Ghostly Prison. It is the exact card giada-angels beats us with. What it replaces is the deck's most white-intensive card and the one skies-v1's own logic argues against: X 2/2 CATS, on the ground, in a deck that dies to the air, as a one-shot at four-plus mana competing directly with casting Approach of the Second Sun. Secure the Wastes stays as the cheap X mana sink at {X}{W}. THE GOLDFISH CANNOT SEE THE POINT OF THIS CARD — no opponents, nothing attacks it, so flying and taxing are invisible and a 3/5 registers as three power. The objective is a RISK check: swapping a scaling X-spell token maker for one fixed body must not cost the board. THE FIRST LINE SET HERE WAS 2.85 AND THE ANCHOR REFUSED IT — the champion reads 2.9506 and this run resolves 0.1012, so a 0.1006 tolerance was inside the noise and could only have come back as whichever side it landed on. 2.80 is outside it. Reset before any measurement was taken, which is the only time a threshold may move.

premise_corrections.claim: a 3/5 FLYING blocker against the seat that took 39 of 53 eliminations with nothing but evasive threats
premise_corrections.correction: The 39/53 figure is a SEAT attribution, not an evasion one. It says which opponent killed this deck, not that the damage flew.
premise_corrections.evidence: The run record holds two separate fields: `eliminated_by {giada-angels: 39, abaddon: 6, baylen-tokens: 8}` (WHO killed this seat) and `eliminated_how {damage: 53}` (HOW). 39 and 53 were read out of different fields and joined into a claim about evasion. No seat's `eliminated_how` holds anything but `damage`, and the string `flying` appears zero times across all four of this deck's sim records. The true statement is that the giada-angels seat took 39 of heliod's 53 damage eliminations in run 996adb84 — a fact about WHICH OPPONENT kills this deck, not about how. Found by the engine-critic 2026-09-22 and confirmed independently against the record; the declaration label was corrected at its root the same day (see goldfish_targets.json `_label_corrections`).
premise_corrections.decision_stands: YES, AND THIS RECORD IS NOT ALTERED. The branch is merged, the card is sleeved, and the case never rested on the premise: the objective's own text says Archangel of Tithes' tax "works whether or not the attacker flies", which is why it was argued as a third Propaganda beside Ghostly Prison. What is wrong is the evasion framing around a sound argument — and the seat fact that survives (giada-angels is what kills this deck) still points at the same card.
premise_corrections.note: APPENDED, NOT REWRITTEN. A merged branch record is a frozen decision — which list, which report, which grade, accepted on a stated date. Rewriting the reasoning would falsify the record of what was decided and why. The correction rides beside it so a reader who meets the old sentence can resolve it.
